operations.name: Provision
operations.description: Buy a US phone number for your AI agent. Searches for and purchases a real US phone number from the telephony provider, then attaches it to the specified AI agent. Once attached, the agent can make outbound calls and receive inbound calls on this number. Each AI agent can only have ONE active phone number. Costs $2.00 per number. Request body: - agent_id: str (required) — the AI agent to assign th

agent_id.description: ID of the AI agent to assign this phone number to (e.g. 'agt_abc123')

country.description: Country code for the phone number (currently only 'US' is supported)

area_code.description: Preferred 3-digit US area code (e.g. '212' for NYC, '415' for SF, '310' for LA)

pattern.description: Legacy digit pattern match (prefer area_code instead)

operations.name: Create agent
operations.description: Create a new AI voice agent for telephony. Sets up a new AI phone agent with a custom system prompt, voice, and greeting. Once created, buy a phone number and attach it to this agent so it can make and receive calls autonomously. Fields: - name: Display name for the agent - system_prompt: Instructions that define the agent's personality and behavior on calls - initial_greeting: What the AI agent s

name.description: Display name for the AI voice agent

system_prompt.description: Default instructions for the agent's personality and behavior on ALL calls (inbound and outbound). Can be overridden per-call via POST /v1/calls.

initial_greeting.description: Default opening line spoken on ALL calls (inbound and outbound), e.g. 'Hello, how can I help you today?'. Can be overridden per-call via POST /v1/calls.

voice_id.description: TTS voice preset name (e.g. 'female-1', 'male-1') or Cartesia voice UUID; defaults to system voice if not set

transfer_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format to transfer calls to (e.g. a human operator fallback)

voicemail_message.description: Message the AI agent leaves if the call goes to voicemail

owner_phone.description: Owner's phone number in E.164 format (e.g. '+12125551234'). Calls from this number enter task mode — the agent treats speech as executable instructions.

operations.name: Delete agent
operations.description: Delete an AI voice agent. Permanently removes the agent, its calls, messages, and conversations, and detaches any phone numbers assigned to it. Detached numbers remain active on your account and can be reassigned to another agent.

operations.name: Delete webhook
operations.description: Remove an agent's webhook. No events for that agent will be delivered via HTTP afterwards; they remain available via GET /v1/events (the mailbox).

operations.name: Get balance
operations.description: Get your AI telephony account balance and rate card. Returns the current balance, currency, billing rates for calls, phone numbers, and inbound SMS, plus what the balance can cover. Use this to check affordability before paid telephony operations.

operations.name: Get account voice
operations.description: Get the current account-level default voice for AI phone agents. Returns which voice is used for all AI agents under this account unless overridden at the agent level or per-call. Controls how your AI agents sound during phone conversations.

operations.name: Get agent
operations.description: Get details of a specific AI voice agent. Returns the agent's full configuration including system prompt, voice settings, greeting, and transfer number.

operations.name: Get call expenditure
operations.description: List individual call charges from AI agent phone calls. Each entry includes the voice call duration, cost, direction (inbound/outbound), phone numbers involved, and timestamp. Shows exactly how much each AI agent call cost.

limit.description: Maximum number of call charges to return (1-200)

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

operations.name: Get call
operations.description: Get full details of a specific voice call. Returns the call's metadata including direction, phone numbers, status, duration, AI agent configuration used, and the full conversation transcript between the AI agent and the caller.

operations.name: Get transcript
operations.description: Get the full conversation transcript for a call. Returns the complete speech-to-text transcript of the phone call, with each turn labeled by role ("human" for the caller, "assistant" for the AI agent). Useful for reviewing what was said on the call, extracting information, or auditing AI agent behavior.

operations.name: Get expenditure
operations.description: Get a detailed expenditure breakdown for AI telephony usage. Shows total spend split by category (voice calls, phone number provisioning, top-ups, refunds) with counts and averages. Useful for tracking how much your AI agents are spending on phone calls and phone numbers.

operations.name: Get number expenditure
operations.description: List phone number provisioning charges. Shows the cost of each phone number bought for your AI agents, including the number, country, and current status.

limit.description: Maximum number of number charges to return (1-200)

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

operations.name: Get number
operations.description: Get details of a specific phone number. Returns the phone number, its assigned AI agent, provider ID, country, and current status.

operations.name: Get spending summary
operations.description: Month-over-month spending summary. Returns total debits grouped by month for trend analysis.

operations.name: Get webhooks
operations.description: List the account's per-agent webhook configuration(s). Secrets are **masked**. Pass `agent_id` to inspect a single agent's webhook. The full secret is only ever shown once, on the POST that creates/replaces it.

agent_id.description: Inspect one agent's webhook (omit to list all)

operations.name: Hangup call
operations.description: Hang up an active phone call. Programmatically terminates an in-progress voice call. Use this when the AI agent needs to end the conversation, or to force-stop a call that is no longer needed. The call's final transcript and billing are processed automatically after hangup.

operations.name: List agents
operations.description: List all AI voice agents configured on your account. Returns every AI phone agent you've created, including their system prompts, voice settings, and associated phone numbers. Useful for checking which agents are ready to make or receive calls.

operations.name: Get available voices
operations.description: List all available voice presets for AI phone agents. Returns named TTS (text-to-speech) voice presets that can be used when configuring AI agents or making phone calls. Each voice defines how your AI agent sounds on the phone. You can use a preset name (e.g. "female-1", "male-1") or pass any valid Cartesia voice UUID directly as a voice_id.

operations.name: List calls
operations.description: List voice calls made by your AI agents. Returns call history with optional filters by agent or status. Each entry includes direction (inbound/outbound), duration, phone numbers, and current status. Filters: - agent_id: only calls for a specific AI agent - status: "initiated", "in-progress", "completed", or "failed"

agent_id.description: Filter calls by AI agent ID

limit.description: Maximum number of calls to return (1-200)

offset.description: Number of calls to skip for pagination

operations.name: List conversations
operations.description: List all SMS conversations for your AI agents. Returns conversation threads, optionally filtered by AI agent. Each conversation represents an ongoing SMS exchange between an AI agent's phone number and an external contact.

operations.name: List messages
operations.description: List SMS messages sent and received by your AI agents. Returns message history with optional filters by AI agent or conversation. Each entry includes direction (inbound/outbound), phone numbers, message body, and delivery status.

agent_id.description: Filter messages by AI agent ID

conversation_id.description: Filter messages by conversation thread ID

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (1-200)

offset.description: Number of messages to skip for pagination

operations.name: List numbers
operations.description: List all phone numbers provisioned on your account. Returns every phone number you've bought for your AI agents, including which agent each number is assigned to, the number's status (active/released), and country.

operations.name: Reassign number
operations.description: Reassign a phone number to a different AI agent. Moves an existing phone number from one AI agent to another. The target agent must not already have an active number assigned. The phone number remains active — only the agent ownership changes.

operations.name: Reset account voice
operations.description: Reset account voice to the system default. Removes the account-level voice override so all AI agents fall back to the system default voice during phone calls (unless they have their own voice_id configured).

operations.name: Send message
operations.description: Send an outbound SMS message from an AI agent's phone number.

from_number_id.description: Specific phone number ID to send from; defaults to the agent's assigned number

operations.name: Set webhook
operations.description: Create or replace an agent's webhook. The configured URL receives ALL of that agent's event types — call lifecycle (`call.received`, `call.completed`, `call.failed`), SMS (`sms.received`), and future events — as signed JSON POSTs. Each agent may have at most one webhook; POSTing again replaces it. - `agent_id`: the agent whose events this webhook receives (required). - `secret`: HMAC signing secre

url.description: HTTPS URL that will receive this agent's events as signed JSON POSTs. Setting this replaces any existing webhook for the agent.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent whose events this webhook receives. Each agent may have at most one webhook.

signature_header.description: Header name for the HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body. Defaults to 'X-Webhook-Signature' (natively verified by Hermes, OpenClaw, and other agent platforms). Set to 'X-Hub-Signature-256' for GitHub-style verification, or any custom header name your platform expects. Omit to keep the existing value when updating.

operations.name: Test webhook
operations.description: Fire a signed `webhook.test` event to the agent's webhook. Uses the exact same event bus (publish_event) that real telephony events use, so a successful delivery confirms the entire pipeline is wired correctly. Returns 404 if no webhook is configured for the agent.

operations.name: Update agent
operations.description: Update an AI voice agent's configuration. Modify any combination of the agent's settings: system prompt, voice, greeting, transfer number, or voicemail message. Changes take effect on the next call the agent handles. Only include the fields you want to change — unset fields are preserved.

name.description: New display name for the AI voice agent

system_prompt.description: Updated default instructions for ALL future calls (does not affect calls already in progress)

initial_greeting.description: Updated default greeting for ALL future calls (inbound and outbound)

voice_id.description: New TTS voice preset name or Cartesia voice UUID

transfer_number.description: Updated transfer phone number in E.164 format

owner_phone.description: Updated owner phone number in E.164 format for task mode
